set.body:
.fmri_lm_build_config computes the full normalization at R/fmrilm.R:393-418 and
then throws it away at :420 when engine_cfg is an fmri_lm_config. The apparent
merge at :431-434 is a self-assignment no-op, because cfg IS engine_cfg by then:

  cfg$robust <- engine_cfg$robust                    # no-op
  cfg$ar <- utils::modifyList(cfg$ar, engine_cfg$ar) # no-op

Verified end to end on a real fit:
  cor_struct="ar2"                                   -> ar$struct = ar2
  cor_struct="ar2" + cfg=control(ar_options=iid)     -> ar$struct = iid

A user combining the two gets IID while believing they asked for AR(2).

cfg is itself undocumented - it is read from dots at R/fmrilm.R:206 and appears in
no @param block. 4 call sites use it.

Fix: error when cfg is supplied alongside any other configuration argument.
set.title: Fix: cfg= silently discards all other configuration arguments
